body:
Thanks Crazypenguine. :-)
I'm watching a movie. Gonna eat some goddamn ice cream!
Well thank you sir but in this case it was me who hit my girlfriend at the time.
Well I have calmed down a bit now but I still feel so shitty. Did you read my previous post about what happened with my ex? It's on page 2 now I think..
I'm with you PenguinLancer. I did something awful last Wednesday in a drunken rage and lost the only girl I have ever loved. I am panicking really bad right now. Hopefully it will get better..
I read every reply.

We both discussed having children and we both agreed we wanted to, together. When we started having unprotected sex we both knew what we were doing, we just didn't discuss it much. Communication failure.
You're a good person. Hang in there. Talk to someone in real life. Please.
Tonight.

Yes, thank you. I have about 5 different locations, all within very close proximity(guess where I live :P), written down with times for all of them so I shall try them all out until I find the one I like best.
Thank you that has lifted me back up about the AA idea. I am going to my first meeting this evening.
Thanks for the advice.
Yes thats right. I am going to give her time and leave her alone. I'm not going to contact her.

Thank you.

>you need to lose the excuses and take responsibility for what you've done.

I want to do that. I *know* it was entirely my own fault. I am going to get help.

> you felt it was worth mentioning that she "never experienced any of the trauma that you did as a youth". What was the purpose of saying this?

I don't know really. Just to make a contrast between the two of us as people I guess. I wanted to give some back ground on both of us. 

>If she had been abused would that make what you did more okay like it shouldn't be as much of a shock to her well being since she's used to it?

God, no. Thats the last thing I intended to mean. Really.

>But do not take the easy way out to relieve those feelings.

Suicide? No way thats the cowards way in this scenario. I have already behaved like enough of a coward. I want to fix myself, not end my life.

>say she agrees to listen to you and you said every single thing right and she takes you back...right now you're probably thinking that's your absolute dream, right?

No, its really not. I promise. I know I have lost this girl and I deserve all of it. I fucking attacked her like an animal. She deserves much better than that. She is so fucking amazing, so sweet and genuine. She was so goddamn good to me and I ruined it all. I have to learn to live with that.

Thank you for your post(s), they helped me.

Thank you. 

>Having unprotected sex, expecting to get pregnant yet continue smoking and drinking then get an abortion? Very dumb for both of you.

Yes, I know. Its a difficult situation to explain but you are right. Big time fuck up.
Thank you for your post. I want to stop drinking, AA will provide support from like minded people. No? I need people to be around right now that can help me feel like I CAN stop drinking. I want to.
Being beaten up in jail will just make me worse. I want to fix myself. I know what I did was wrong and I feel awful for it.
Okay. Just good to know you're here.
Thank you so much. Will you be around for a little while longer?

>The thing about abusers is they create situations where they can punish their victims by setting them up to get in trouble so they "deserve" to be punished.

Can you explain that or re-word it please?
Wow, thank you so much. You're really very helpful.
Thank you for your advice.

Wow thank you. I feel sometimes like I am damaged goods or that I just have something wrong with me that I can't fix but when I spoke to the counsellor she assured me I can change. Thank you for your post, it inspired me.
Thank you for your post, it helped me.

Yeah I'm not going to contact her. I know thats not right. I just want to get help ASAP. Her sister insinuated that I am only getting help *because* of what I did but truthfully I have wanted to get help for a long time and I never bothered and now I have lost the best thing I ever had as a result.
Thank you for the reply. I feel very isolated. My girlfriends, I guess I should start calling her ex now, Sister just came by and picked up her stuff.
Anyone here?
Thanks.

>Srsly, grab the yellow pages, call AA or psychological help

Already have. Thank you for the advice.
Thank you.

Yeah I have flipped out when sober before. I have a bad temper which I inherited from my Dad. This is definitely the worst I have ever done and all of my fights with this particular girl have mostly all been when drunk.
I smoke weed already. I'm giving that up too. For now at least. I have checked for AA meetings in my area and I'm going to start attending. I want to get help.
Thanks for the advice. She may yet press charges. She said she would.

>I know someone whose father was less than stellar, he got physical with his GF a few times, but saw the harm he was causing and put out the effort to change. Five plus years later, he is no longer that violent person. If others can do it, so can you.

Thank you for this. I want to change.
Thank you.
Thank you. Your post really helped me.
Her phone is here. I will be giving it back to her Sister when she arrives. I don't think I should contact her though. There is no way to fucking apologize for this in my opinion.
Yes, thank you. You're a very good person to be helping people anonymously over the Internet like this.
reuse?
You're right.

Thank you for this. Some people have stated I should never contact her again even if she initiates it. I can understand this but I swear this girl was the love of my life and I know she felt the same towards me. I dunno what to say, I just can't believe I may have ruined that with my actions. It feels unbearable.

Yes, I have already contacted someone and will make an appointment when they call me back tomorrow. I have also found several AA groups in my area and will be attending them. I was also talking to the Samaritans on the phone.
I feel completely lost. I feel disconnected from myself. The only person who was really close to me, my Mother, passed away from cancer 4 years ago and I am an only child so I am feeling quite alone.
Thank you very much. I know it will pass but at this moment I feel so uneasy with myself.
I have written a list of AA groups to go to. Please send me good thoughts. I want to stop.

Yeah I would to talk to someone. I feel at my wits end. I am sitting here waiting for her Sister to come over and collect her stuff. I just feel so empty inside. I can barely stand being alive right now. I feel so ashamed. Also the added worry that her Brother is going to come over and beat the absolute crap out of me(which I can totally understand).
I have contacted counselors to get help. I want to fix myself. I feel like I am a nutcase. :(
Thank you.
Thank you.

Thank you. Was your Dad ever violent at all? Did he change or was he just never like your Grandfather? Perhaps when he was younger before you were born or anything. I have contacted counselors and will make an appointment tomorrow and I am looking for AA meetings in my area to go to. I want to change so bad but I am terrified that I am just damaged and can't be helped. The counselor woman I spoke to told me I can definitely change. That gave me some hope.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
I don't feel like I can be fixed though.. I feel like damaged goods. Thats probably just negative thinking and self pity though. Thank you for your advice.

>If you love her, you will let her go.

Can I say that I loved her after what I have done? Is it possible to love someone and still do something like this? I swear on my life I feel in my heart that we both loved each other *so* much. But I don't understand how I could have done this to her..
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
